modes.F: fidelity: ja, 4:3, native 320x240 canvas; exact equality
modes.E: English: state trace identical to F; pixels may differ only inside source-declared text/art regions
modes.M: modern presentation: inner 320x240 canvas hash and trace identical to F; only pixels outside the canvas may change

statuses.exact: passes only on exact RGBA (frame), identical iteration counts (frame_timing) or identical in-scope fields (state)
statuses.known_diff: pinned residual; fails if the residual grows or its bbox moves; promote when exact
statuses.unsynchronizable: listed with its reason and never compared

policy.data: No original pixels, RAM or text are committed: entries hold predicates, hashes, counts and .asset-cache paths only.

defects.summary: D1: color_cut branch of first_arrival_media_bridge.gd never writes D_801220E0..E2 (port leaves 63, native writes 0x80 at stage8 substep1)
D2: port draws the post-update bg_layers state one iteration early at stage9 substep 2-3 (source draws dec_bg_draw(1) before setting bg_layers)
D3: CD read / XA voice-start service latency of the measured rei-lines16-v3 run, with consequences D4 (actor96 x) and D5 (rand() blink count); fidelity default reproduces the original latency
C1: checker phase driven by D_800B5BCC/D0 not captured on either side; emulator x=0 column and y=0 row (declared exclusions); residual sits in the HUD frame and message window (y>=160)
D6: open low-amplitude scene differences (one RGB555 step, GPU dither or modulation rounding candidates) and message-window interior differences with no proven cause

Port colour expansion is mixed (v<<3 in calendar/date/event/ending presenters, bit replication in first_arrival_actor_renderer.gd); exact RGBA differs on every pair until the user picks a rule. No presenter changes before that decision.
first-school pair is not iteration-matched: native settled shot has title timer 184, port capture 116; title-inclusive (32) and dialogue-only (27) glyph counts are incompatible domains
